```
TYPE ST_AnalogChannel :
STRUCT
    enable : BOOL;
    hiLIM : REAL;
    loLIM : REAL;
    bipolar : BOOL;
    measuringMode : INT;
    retVal : WORD;
    outputValue : REAL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_AnalogBatchProcessing
VAR_INPUT
    count : DINT;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    analogValues : ARRAY[*] OF INT;
    channels : ARRAY[*] OF ST_AnalogChannel;
END_VAR
VAR
    analogLower : DINT;
    analogUpper : DINT;
    channelLower : DINT;
    channelUpper : DINT;
    analogCount : DINT;
    channelCount : DINT;
    processCount : DINT;
    i : DINT;
    analogIndex : DINT;
    channelIndex : DINT;
    rawValue : INT;
    rawReal : REAL;
    scale : REAL;
END_VAR
```
No `VAR_OUTPUT`.

Implementation:
```
analogLower := LOWER_BOUND(analogValues, 1);
analogUpper := UPPER_BOUND(analogValues, 1);
channelLower := LOWER_BOUND(channels, 1);
channelUpper := UPPER_BOUND(channels, 1);

analogCount := analogUpper - analogLower + 1;
channelCount := channelUpper - channelLower + 1;

processCount := count;
IF processCount > analogCount THEN
    processCount := analogCount;
END_IF
IF processCount > channelCount THEN
    processCount := channelCount;
END_IF
IF processCount < 0 THEN
    processCount := 0;
END_IF

FOR i := 0 TO processCount - 1 DO
    analogIndex := analogLower + i;
    channelIndex := channelLower + i;

    IF channels[channelIndex].enable THEN
        rawValue := analogValues[analogIndex];

        IF (channels[channelIndex].measuringMode < 0) OR
           (channels[channelIndex].measuringMode > 2) THEN
            channels[channelIndex].retVal := 16#8001;
        ELSIF channels[channelIndex].hiLIM <= channels[channelIndex].loLIM THEN
            channels[channelIndex].retVal := 16#8002;
        ELSE
            CASE channels[channelIndex].measuringMode OF
                0:
                    rawReal := INT_TO_REAL(rawValue);
                    IF channels[channelIndex].bipolar THEN
                        scale := (rawReal + 27648.0) / 55296.0;
                    ELSE
                        scale := rawReal / 27648.0;
                    END_IF;
                    channels[channelIndex].outputValue :=
                        channels[channelIndex].loLIM +
                        scale * (channels[channelIndex].hiLIM - channels[channelIndex].loLIM);
                1:
                    channels[channelIndex].outputValue := INT_TO_REAL(rawValue) / 10.0;
                2:
                    channels[channelIndex].outputValue := INT_TO_REAL(rawValue) / 100.0;
            END_CASE;
            channels[channelIndex].retVal := 0;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;
```
